title: Förstudie Gotland: Förbättrad leveranssäkerhet och ökad kapacitet för ytterligare förnybar elproduktion
version: Vattenfall R&D report VRD-R42:2018, 6 December 2018, hosted by the Swedish Energy Agency

passages.note: Vattenfall reports that Gotland 1 entered service with mercury-arc valves in 1954. The converter stations added thyristor equipment in series with the mercury-arc equipment in 1970, raising line capacity to 30 MW. The original cable and terminal equipment were decommissioned and dismantled in 1986.
